question: Should generic tool-progress intent be a supported public Plugin SDK contract, or remain a bundled/internal cross-plugin seam?
rationale: The PR adds public callable SDK surface whose marker directly controls message suppression; implementation review cannot safely choose that permanent compatibility boundary.

options.title: Document public contract
options.body: Keep the exported kind and predicate, document strict transient-only producer semantics, and add focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Internalize the seam
options.body: Move the marker and predicate to a bundled-only runtime boundary while retaining the Slack suppression behavior.

recommendation.title: Document public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the exported kind and predicate, document strict transient-only producer semantics, and add focused compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to both Slack delivery ownership and Plugin SDK surface decisions.
